begin: Click the mouse on a position of your choice.  You are the dark pieces.
mustSkip: You can't move, so please click the "Skip Turn" button.
skipNotYourTurn: But it's the computer's turn to play!
skipNoGame: You must start a new game before you can skip your turn.
gameFinished: This game is finished.  You must start a new game before you can move again.
notYourTurn: Sorry, it's not your turn to move.  The computer is thinking.
clickPosition: Please click on a board position.
occupied: Sorry, that board position has already been chosen.
invalidMove: Choose an empty position that flips at least one computer position.

userMove.one: Your move is row {{row}} and column {{col}} with one reversed position.
userMove.other: Your move is row {{row}} and column {{col}} with {{count}} reverses.

computerMove.one: Computer's move is row {{row}} and column {{col}} with one reversed position.
computerMove.other: Computer's move is row {{row}} and column {{col}} with {{count}} reverses.

newBoard: New game board is {{rows}} rows by {{cols}} columns.
tooNarrow: The window is too narrow to display {{cols}} columns.
tooShort: The window is too short to display {{rows}} rows.
computerCantMove: The computer can't move, so it's your turn again.
endComputerWins: Nobody can move.  Computer wins, {{comp}} positions to your {{user}} positions.
endUserWins: Nobody can move.  You win with {{user}} positions to the computer's {{comp}} positions.
endTie: Nobody can move.  Game is tied.  We both have {{count}} positions.
